pages.title: Gain and delayed response
pages.text:
Gain and delayed response
The pressure ﬁlter and blood redistribution delay the rate response.
A larger gain reduces
the static oﬀset while potentially increasing oscillatory transient behavior.
Computational Cardiology Notes 19 / 20

pages.title: Quantities retained by this controller
pages.text:
Quantities retained by this controller
Rate control changes cycle timing. It does not independently regulate contractility,
vascular tone or venous return.
A centered plotting average is not the causal pressure ﬁlter
used by the controller.
